justification: `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/model/assembly/x86/` contains only `AssemblyParserX86`, `X86Directive`, and `X86RegisterType`. `AssemblyParserX86` depends on shared `org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.model.assembly` types (`AbstractAssemblyParser`, `Architecture`, `AssemblyInstruction`, `AssemblyLabels`, `AssemblyUtil`) plus `JITWatchConstants` (`AssemblyParserX86.java`), and that parent assembly layer is reused broadly in `AbstractAssemblyParser.java`, `AssemblyUtil.java`, `HotSpotLogParser.java`, `AbstractMetaMember.java`, `IMetaMember.java`, and `ViewerAssembly.java`. The x86 package itself is only imported by `AbstractAssemblyParser.java`, `AssemblyUtil.java`, and `ViewerAssembly.java`, so I found no evidence that it depends on a less-stable package.
